desc:
Welcome to +1 Poop for Brainrots 💩🧠

Eat more, get fatter, and poop farther to collect the rarest Brainrots! Build up insane Fat, launch your poop across huge distances, and race to claim the best Brainrots before time runs out! 💥

How to play:
🍔 Eat Food to increase your Fat
💩 Poop farther to reach better Brainrots
🏃 Upgrade your Speed to travel farther before the timer ends
🍕 Buy better Food to gain Fat even faster
🗼 Upgrade your Tower to poop from greater heights
💵 Collect Brainrots to earn Cash and grow your collection

💤 Your Brainrots generate Cash even while OFFLINE!

♻️ Rebirth to multiply your earnings and become even stronger!

🔥 Unlock powerful new Brainrots and reach the highest tiers!

👍 Like the game and join the group for FREE rewards!
